tokens.name: bg
tokens.usage: The terminal ground. Homepage, sessions, every TUI screen. In other terminals the TUI paints nothing and inherits their background; in the AI Term app this is the window.

tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: One step up from bg: the command bar field, popups (/model, /settings), the frame bar.

tokens.name: surface-2
tokens.usage: The selected row in any list, and key caps. Never a large area.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Box-drawing borders (╭─╮) and dividers. Decorative only: nothing is ever told apart by a border alone.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text on bg, surface and surface-2: titles, typed input, selected item names.

tokens.name: ink-2
tokens.usage: Secondary text on bg, surface and surface-2: engine and model, folders, numbers, the done mark.

tokens.name: ink-3
tokens.usage: Tertiary text on bg, surface and surface-2: placeholders, hints, labels, idle and exited marks. Holds 4.5:1 on all three in both themes.

tokens.name: accent
tokens.usage: AI Term's color. The prompt chevron, the running mark, the cursor in the command bar, links. Text in accent reads on bg, surface and surface-2 in both themes.

tokens.name: on-accent
tokens.usage: Text on an accent fill (the active key cap, a highlighted match). Never plain white or black.

tokens.name: status-running
tokens.usage: The ◐ running mark. Same as accent: working agents are the product's identity.

tokens.name: status-waiting
tokens.usage: The ● waiting mark and the 'n waiting' count. The loudest color in the product: an agent needs you. Never used for decoration.

tokens.name: status-error
tokens.usage: The ✗ error mark, the don't-ask permission marker, failed spawns. Never decoration.

tokens.name: status-done
tokens.usage: The ✓ done mark. Deliberately quiet: done is calm, not a signal.

tokens.name: status-idle
tokens.usage: The · idle and ■ exited marks.

tokens.name: cursor
tokens.usage: The block cursor in the terminal and the command bar.

color.note: Dark values = Graphite (chosen 2026-10-11). Other dark palettes (ink, slate) and auto (match the terminal's own background) are defined in docs/design.md.

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "SF Pro Text", "Segoe UI", system-ui, sans-serif

styles.name: cell
styles.sample: › What do you want to build?
styles.usage: Everything in the TUI. One character = one cell; the whole UI is laid out on this grid.

styles.name: cell-strong
styles.usage: Emphasis inside the grid: section labels, the selected item, the waiting count. The TUI has no other sizes.

styles.name: chrome-body
styles.usage: AI Term app (v0.5) window chrome outside the terminal: menus, the title strip.

styles.name: chrome-meta
styles.usage: Secondary chrome text in the app.

styles.name: chrome-caption
styles.usage: Small labels in the app chrome.

spacing.note: Inside the TUI, spacing is counted in cells (columns and rows), not pixels. The px steps are for the AI Term app chrome.

tokens.name: cell-x
tokens.usage: One column: the advance of one character at 13px JetBrains Mono. Indents and gutters in the TUI are whole columns.

tokens.name: cell-y
tokens.usage: One row (13px × 1.2 line height, rounded). Vertical spacing in the TUI is whole rows.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: App chrome: icon-to-label gap.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: App chrome: tight padding.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: App chrome: terminal side padding.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: App chrome: panel padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: App chrome: section spacing.

tokens.name: radius-0
tokens.usage: Everything in the TUI. Rounded corners there come from box-drawing glyphs (╭╮╰╯), not radius.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: App chrome: buttons and inputs.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: App chrome: popovers.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: App chrome: the window's own panels.
